dishes.name: Galette-saucisse
dishes.desc: A grilled pork sausage rolled in a hot buckwheat galette, the street food of Rennes, sold at the Lices market and outside the football stadium.

dishes.name: Galette complète
dishes.desc: Savoury buckwheat galette with ham, egg and Emmental, served with cider. Saint-Malo and Rennes are old crêperie towns where buckwheat is a daily food.

dishes.name: Craquelins de Saint-Malo
dishes.desc: Thin, crisp, lightly sweet biscuits made in Saint-Malo since the 19th century, once sold in the walled town's shops. Eaten with butter, jam or cheese.

dishes.name: Saint-Brieuc scallops
dishes.local: Coquilles Saint-Jacques de la baie de Saint-Brieuc
dishes.desc: Scallops dredged in the Bay of Saint-Brieuc from October to April under a protected label. Eaten seared, in a galette or with leeks and cream.

dishes.name: Bouchot mussels
dishes.local: Moules de bouchot de la baie du Mont-Saint-Michel
dishes.desc: Small, sweet mussels grown on wooden poles in the bay around Cancale and Vivier-sur-Mer, protected by an AOP. Steamed with cream or cider.
